impact.text: Funds accounting becomes inconsistent: users see positive pendingQuote but the distributor has pending tracked under a different token key.

precondition_sources.text: The pool exists and has totalShares > 0.
The attacker deploys fakeToken and approves the Distributor to spend it.

intent_sources.text: The token pair passed into addRewards must exactly match the configured pool pair {launchAsset, rs.quoteAsset}.
